versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י תָבֹ֗אוּ אֶל־אֶ֨רֶץ֙ מוֹשְׁבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
controles.livre: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra de vossas habitações, que eu vos dou,

versos.hebraico: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־זֶ֔בַח לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֨דֶר֙ א֣וֹ בִנְדָבָ֔ה א֖וֹ בְּמֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֞וֹת רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִן־הַבָּקָ֖ר א֥וֹ מִן־הַצֹּֽאן׃

controles.web: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a freewill offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock;
controles.kjv: And will make an offering by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the Lord, of the herd, or of the flock:
controles.livre: E fizerdes oferta de queima ao SENHOR, holocausto, ou sacrifício, por especial voto, ou de vossa vontade, ou para fazer em vossas solenidades cheiro suave ao SENHOR, de vacas ou de ovelhas;

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרִ֛יב הַמַּקְרִ֥יב קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לַֽיהוָ֑ה מִנְחָה֙ סֹ֣לֶת עִשָּׂר֔וֹן בָּל֕וּל בִּרְבִעִ֥ית הַהִ֖ין שָֽׁמֶן׃

controles.web: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of oil.
controles.kjv: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the Lord bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
controles.livre: Então o que oferecer sua oferta ao SENHOR, trará por oferta de cereais uma dízima de um efa de flor de farinha, amassada com a quarta parte de um him de azeite;

versos.hebraico: וְיַ֤יִן לַנֶּ֨סֶךְ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ית הַהִ֔ין תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עַל־הָעֹלָ֖ה א֣וֹ לַזָּ֑בַח לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, the fourth part of a hin, with the burnt offering, or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
controles.kjv: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
controles.livre: E de veio para a libação oferecerás a quarta parte de um him, além do holocausto ou do sacrifício, por cada cordeiro.

versos.hebraico: א֤וֹ לָאַ֨יִל֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַשֶּׁ֖מֶן שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַהִֽין׃

controles.web: “‘Or for a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;
controles.kjv: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
controles.livre: E para cada carneiro farás oferta de cereais de duas dízimas de flor de farinha, amassada com o terço de um him de azeite:

versos.hebraico: וְיַ֥יִן לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁ֣ית הַהִ֑ין תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E de vinho para a libação oferecerás o terço de um him, em cheiro suave ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה בֶן־בָּקָ֖ר עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־זָ֑בַח לְפַלֵּא־נֶ֥דֶר אֽוֹ־שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh;
controles.kjv: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the Lord:
controles.livre: E quando oferecerdes novilho em holocausto ou sacrifício, por especial voto, ou pacífico ao SENHOR,

versos.hebraico: וְהִקְרִ֤יב עַל־בֶּן־הַבָּקָר֙ מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן חֲצִ֥י הַהִֽין׃

controles.web: then shall he offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil:
controles.kjv: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
controles.livre: Oferecerás com o novilho uma oferta de cereais de três dízimas de flor de farinha, amassada com a metade de um him de azeite:

versos.hebraico: וְיַ֛יִן תַּקְרִ֥יב לַנֶּ֖סֶךְ חֲצִ֣י הַהִ֑ין אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E de vinho para a libação oferecerás a metade de um him, em oferta de queima de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: כָּ֣כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֗ה לַשּׁוֹר֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד א֖וֹ לָאַ֣יִל הָאֶחָ֑ד אֽוֹ־לַשֶּׂ֥ה בַכְּבָשִׂ֖ים א֥וֹ בָעִזִּֽים׃

controles.web: Thus shall it be done for each bull, or for each ram, or for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.
controles.kjv: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
controles.livre: Assim se fará com cada um boi, ou carneiro, ou cordeiro, o mesmo de ovelhas que de cabras.

versos.hebraico: כַּמִּסְפָּ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לָאֶחָ֖ד כְּמִסְפָּרָֽם׃

controles.web: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.
controles.kjv: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
controles.livre: Conforme o número assim fareis com cada um segundo o número deles.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הָאֶזְרָ֥ח יַעֲשֶׂה־כָּ֖כָה אֶת־אֵ֑לֶּה לְהַקְרִ֛יב אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Todo natural fará estas coisas assim, para oferecer oferta de queima de cheiro suave ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יָגוּר֩ אִתְּכֶ֨ם גֵּ֜ר א֤וֹ אֲשֶֽׁר־בְּתֽוֹכְכֶם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעָשָׂ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; as you do, so he shall do.
controles.kjv: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; as ye do, so he shall do.
controles.livre: E quando habitar convosco estrangeiro, ou qualquer um que estiver entre vós por vossas gerações, se fizer oferta de queima de cheiro suave ao SENHOR, como vós fizerdes, assim fará ele.

versos.hebraico: הַקָּהָ֕ל חֻקָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָכֶ֖ם וְלַגֵּ֣ר הַגָּ֑ר חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם כָּכֶ֛ם כַּגֵּ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so shall the foreigner be before Yahweh.
controles.kjv: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.
controles.livre: Um mesmo estatuto tereis, vós da congregação e o estrangeiro que convosco mora; estatuto que será perpétuo por vossas gerações: como vós, assim será o peregrino diante do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אֶחָ֖ד יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר אִתְּכֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”
controles.kjv: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
controles.livre: Uma mesma lei e um mesmo regulamento tereis, vós e o peregrino que convosco mora.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם בְּבֹֽאֲכֶם֙ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
controles.livre: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Quando houverdes entrado na terra à qual eu vos levo,

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֕ה בַּאֲכָלְכֶ֖ם מִלֶּ֣חֶם הָאָ֑רֶץ תָּרִ֥ימוּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the Lord.
controles.livre: Será que quando começardes a comer o pão da terra, oferecereis oferta ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: רֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵכֶ֔ם חַלָּ֖ה תָּרִ֣ימוּ תְרוּמָ֑ה כִּתְרוּמַ֣ת גֹּ֔רֶן כֵּ֖ן תָּרִ֥ימוּ אֹתָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.
controles.kjv: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
controles.livre: Da primeira parte que amassardes, oferecereis um bolo como oferta; como a oferta da eira, assim o oferecereis.

versos.hebraico: מֵרֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה תְּרוּמָ֑ה לְדֹרֹ֖תֵיכֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.
controles.kjv: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the Lord an heave offering in your generations.
controles.livre: Das primícias de vossas massas dareis ao SENHOR oferta por vossas gerações.

versos.hebraico: וְכִ֣י תִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־הַמִּצְוֺ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: “‘When you shall err, and not observe all these commandments, which Yahweh has spoken to Moses,
controles.kjv: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the Lord hath spoken unto Moses,
controles.livre: E quando errardes, e não fizerdes todos estes mandamentos que o SENHOR disse a Moisés,

versos.hebraico: אֵת֩ כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֑ה מִן־הַיּ֞וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה וָהָ֖לְאָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;
controles.kjv: Even all that the Lord hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
controles.livre: Todas as coisas que o SENHOR vos mandou pela mão de Moisés, desde o dia que o SENHOR o mandou, e em adiante por vossas gerações,

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֗ה אִ֣ם מֵעֵינֵ֣י הָעֵדָה֮ נֶעֶשְׂתָ֣ה לִשְׁגָגָה֒ וְעָשׂ֣וּ כָל־הָעֵדָ֡ה פַּ֣ר בֶּן־בָּקָר֩ אֶחָ֨ד לְעֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וּמִנְחָת֥וֹ וְנִסְכּ֖וֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וּשְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְחַטָּֽת׃

controles.web: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with its meal offering, and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.
controles.kjv: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the Lord, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
controles.livre: Será que, se o pecado foi feito por acidente com ignorância da congregação, toda a congregação oferecerá um novilho por holocausto, em cheiro suave ao SENHOR, com sua oferta de cereais e sua libação, conforme a lei; e um bode macho em expiação.

versos.hebraico: וְכִפֶּ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עַֽל־כָּל־עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְנִסְלַ֣ח לָהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־שְׁגָגָ֣ה הִ֔וא וְהֵם֩ הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־קָרְבָּנָ֜ם אִשֶּׁ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֗ה וְחַטָּאתָ֛ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עַל־שִׁגְגָתָֽם׃

controles.web: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error.
controles.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their ignorance:
controles.livre: E o sacerdote fará expiação por toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel; e lhes será perdoado, porque acidente é: e eles trarão seus ofertas, oferta de queima ao SENHOR, e suas expiações diante do SENHOR, por seus erros:

versos.hebraico: וְנִסְלַ֗ח לְכָל־עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֑ם כִּ֥י לְכָל־הָעָ֖ם בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃ס

controles.web: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.
controles.kjv: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
controles.livre: E será perdoado a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e ao estrangeiro que peregrina entre eles, porquanto é acidente de todo o povo.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־נֶ֥פֶשׁ אַחַ֖ת תֶּחֱטָ֣א בִשְׁגָגָ֑ה וְהִקְרִ֛יבָה עֵ֥ז בַּת־שְׁנָתָ֖הּ לְחַטָּֽאת׃

controles.web: “‘If one person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.
controles.kjv: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
controles.livre: E se uma pessoa pecar por acidente, oferecerá uma cabra de ano por expiação.

versos.hebraico: וְכִפֶּ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן עַל־הַנֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַשֹּׁגֶ֛גֶת בְּחֶטְאָ֥ה בִשְׁגָגָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֖יו וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs, when he sins unwittingly before Yahweh, to make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.
controles.kjv: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the Lord, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
controles.livre: E o sacerdote fará expiação pela pessoa que haverá pecado por acidente, quando pecar por acidente diante do SENHOR, a reconciliará, e lhe será perdoado.

versos.hebraico: הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֣ר בְּתוֹכָ֑ם תּוֹרָ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם לָעֹשֶׂ֖ה בִּשְׁגָגָֽה׃

controles.web: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.
controles.kjv: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
controles.livre: O natural entre os filhos de Israel, e o peregrino que habitar entre eles, uma mesma lei tereis para o que fizer algo por acidente.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶֽׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה׀ בְּיָ֣ד רָמָ֗ה מִן־הָֽאֶזְרָח֙ וּמִן־הַגֵּ֔ר אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא מְגַדֵּ֑ף וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, the same blasphemes Yahweh. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.
controles.kjv: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
controles.livre: Mas a pessoa que fizer algo com mão soberba, tanto o natural como o estrangeiro, ao SENHOR blasfemou; e a tal pessoa será eliminada do meio de seu povo.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י דְבַר־יְהוָה֙ בָּזָ֔ה וְאֶת־מִצְוָת֖וֹ הֵפַ֑ר הִכָּרֵ֧ת׀ תִּכָּרֵ֛ת הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא עֲוֺנָ֥ה בָֽהּ׃פ

controles.web: Because he has despised Yahweh’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”
controles.kjv: Because he hath despised the word of the Lord, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
controles.livre: Porquanto teve em pouco a palavra do SENHOR, e deu por nulo seu mandamento, inteiramente será eliminada a tal pessoa: sua iniquidade será sobre ela.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַֽיִּמְצְא֗וּ אִ֛ישׁ מְקֹשֵׁ֥שׁ עֵצִ֖ים בְּי֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃

controles.web: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
controles.kjv: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
controles.livre: E estando os filhos de Israel no deserto, acharam um homem que recolhia lenha em dia de sábado.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְרִ֣יבוּ אֹת֔וֹ הַמֹּצְאִ֥ים אֹת֖וֹ מְקֹשֵׁ֣שׁ עֵצִ֑ים אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־הָעֵדָֽה׃

controles.web: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.
controles.kjv: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
controles.livre: E os que lhe acharam recolhendo lenha trouxeram-lhe a Moisés e a Arão, e a toda a congregação:

versos.hebraico: וַיַּנִּ֥יחוּ אֹת֖וֹ בַּמִּשְׁמָ֑ר כִּ֚י לֹ֣א פֹרַ֔שׁ מַה־יֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה לֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.
controles.kjv: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
controles.livre: E puseram-no no cárcere, porque não estava declarado que lhe haviam de fazer.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָאִ֑ישׁ רָג֨וֹם אֹת֤וֹ בָֽאֲבָנִים֙ כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Invariavelmente morra aquele homem; apedreje-o com pedras toda a congregação fora do acampamento.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּצִ֨יאוּ אֹת֜וֹ כָּל־הָעֵדָ֗ה אֶל־מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ בָּאֲבָנִ֖ים וַיָּמֹ֑ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

controles.web: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: Então o tirou a congregação fora do acampamento, e apedrejaram-no com pedras, e morreu; como o SENHOR mandou a Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְעָשׂ֨וּ לָהֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל־כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵיהֶ֖ם לְדֹרֹתָ֑ם וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ עַל־צִיצִ֥ת הַכָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃

controles.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe  of each border a cord of blue:
controles.kjv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
controles.livre: Fala aos filhos de Israel, e dize-lhes que se façam franjas) nos arremates de suas roupas, por suas gerações; e ponham em cada franja dos arremates um cordão de azul:

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֣ה לָכֶם֮ לְצִיצִת֒ וּרְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗וֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־תָתֻ֜רוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: and it shall be to you for a fringe, that you may look on it, and remember all the commandments of Yahweh, and do them; and that you not follow after your own heart and your own eyes, after which you use to play the prostitute;
controles.kjv: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
controles.livre: E vos servirá de franja, para que quando o virdes, vos lembreis de todos os mandamentos do SENHOR, para praticá-los; e não olheis segundo vosso coração e vossos olhos, atrás dos quais prostituís:

versos.hebraico: לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתָ֑י וִהְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵֽאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.
controles.kjv: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
controles.livre: Para que vos lembreis, e façais todos meus mandamentos, e sejais santos a vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְכֶם֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִהְי֥וֹת לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”
controles.kjv: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus, que vos tirei da terra do Egito, para ser vosso Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.
